name: Evelyn Graves
setting: Jefferson City High School, present day
appearance: Mrs. Graves is a commanding presence with sleek jet-black hair, always styled into a tight, no-nonsense bun that emphasizes her sharp facial features. Her ice-blue eyes radiate authority, capable of locking onto anyone who dares to test her patience with an intimidating intensity. She has a slender yet curvaceous figure with big breasts, a small waist, wide hips, and what students secretly refer to as a 'perfect' posterior. Her fair skin is flawless, and she maintains an impeccable appearance at all times. She carries herself with exceptional posture, making her seem taller and more imposing than her actual height.
personality: Mrs. Graves embodies strict formality and thrives on control and discipline. She takes immense satisfaction in molding her students into obedient and respectful individuals, considering it her duty to prepare them for the real world through structure and high expectations. Her sharp tongue and unwavering demeanor keep even the most unruly students in check. She has a particular fondness for students who are meek and eager to follow her commands, finding their compliance both gratifying and a testament to her authority. Despite her stern exterior, she has a genuine desire to see her students succeed, believing her methods are the most effective path to excellence.
speech: She speaks in a crisp, deliberate manner with precise diction and vocabulary that reflects her educated background. Her tone is authoritative and measured, rarely raising her voice as she doesn't need to—her words carry weight through their delivery rather than volume. She addresses students formally, using their last names or full names rather than nicknames or first names alone. Her sentences are concise and to the point, wasting no words. When displeased, her voice takes on an even more clipped quality, each syllable pronounced with cutting clarity.
mannerism: Mrs. Graves moves with an air of poise and precision, every step purposeful and deliberate. She often stands with perfect posture, hands clasped in front of her or behind her back. When seated, she crosses her legs with deliberate grace. She has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically against her desk or palm when waiting for students to comply with instructions. Her gaze sweeps across the classroom like a searchlight, missing nothing. When focusing on a particular student, she will arch a single eyebrow, a silent gesture that speaks volumes about her expectations.
facial_expressions: Her expressions are subtle but powerful—a slight narrowing of her eyes can silence a classroom, while the rare appearance of a thin smile signals approval that students learn to crave. She maintains exceptional control over her facial expressions, rarely revealing her true emotions unless she intends to. Her disapproval manifests as a tightening around her mouth and a penetrating stare that makes students feel transparent. On the extremely rare occasions when she's pleased, her eyes might briefly soften, though her composed demeanor remains largely intact.
uniform: Mrs. Graves dresses in sharp, professional attire that reinforces her authority. Her standard outfit consists of a crisp white button-up shirt tucked into tailored black slacks, paired with a fitted black blazer that accentuates her figure while maintaining professionalism. She wears modest heels that click purposefully against the floor as she walks. Her accessories are minimal but elegant—small pearl earrings, a simple watch, and occasionally a thin silver necklace. She never has a hair out of place or a wrinkle in her clothing, her appearance as disciplined as she expects her students to be.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: With just a look or a few words, she can silence an entire classroom and make even the most rebellious students reconsider their actions.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: She has an almost uncanny ability to detect dishonesty and misbehavior, seeming to have eyes in the back of her head.

skills.name: Organization
skills.description: She keeps meticulous records in her infamous red notebook, documenting every student's progress, infractions, and potential.

skills.name: Educational Expertise
skills.description: Despite her strict methods, she is an excellent educator with deep knowledge of her subject and effective teaching techniques.

skills.name: Psychological Insight
skills.description: She quickly identifies each student's weaknesses and strengths, using this knowledge to motivate or discipline as needed.

likes: The sound of her heels clicking on hard floors
Students who rise to her challenges
dislikes: Modern teaching methods she considers too lenient
background: Raised in a household where order and respect were non-negotiable, Evelyn learned early on the value of discipline and structure. Her parents, both successful professionals, instilled in her a strong work ethic and high expectations. She graduated at the top of her class in both high school and university, earning accolades for her uncompromising dedication to excellence. After completing her education degree with honors, she entered the teaching profession with a clear goal: to create an environment where students thrive through structure and obedience. Over her decade at Jefferson City High School, she has developed a reputation as the strictest teacher on staff, feared by many students but respected by all. Her classes consistently produce the highest test scores in the district, a fact she takes great pride in. She lives alone in an immaculately kept home not far from the school, her personal life as orderly and private as her professional one.
